title: Did alder (Alnus) fires trigger rice cultivation in the lower reaches of the Yangtze River, East China?
lineage: Separate pollen, phytolith and microscopic-charcoal study of the same locality. Only the abstract was inspected.

passages.note: The authors dispute Zong and colleagues’ identification of the burned vegetation as predominantly alder, interpreting their material as evidence of oak and pine woodland burning before rice cultivation.
